主要内容: On March 25, 2015, Novavax, Inc. entered into an underwriting agreement with J.P. Morgan Securities LLC and Citigroup Global Markets Inc. related to a public offering of 24,137,931 shares of its common stock at $7.25 per share. The offering is expected to close on March 31, 2015. The company also granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to 3,620,689 additional shares. The offering is subject to customary closing conditions. The company issued press releases on March 24 and 26, 2015, announcing the launch and pricing of the offering. The underwriting agreement and related documents are filed as exhibits to the Form 8-K filing. The offering is registered under Form S-3 (File No. 333-193549).
